# pre-commit-checklists-demo

> A small, realistic consumer of the pre-commit-checklists library: real
> sample files, a real `.pre-commit-config.yaml` pinned to a `rev:` tag, and
> real hooks catching real problems. Not the library itself, and not another
> copy of it.
> Apache License 2.0. Author: Ivan Pinatti (https://github.com/ivan-pinatti).
> Canonical repository: https://github.com/ivan-pinatti/pre-commit-checklists-demo

## What it does

This repository is a tiny log rotation and disk usage utility wired up to
thirteen hook ids from
[pre-commit-checklists](https://github.com/ivan-pinatti/pre-commit-checklists),
so a reader can see the library working end to end before adopting it: a
real `repo:`/`rev:` pin, real fixture files that each hook id is meant to
catch problems in, and a recorded account of what was actually run and
verified.

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md): What this demonstrates, how to run it, and what
  was verified
- [.pre-commit-config.yaml](.pre-commit-config.yaml): The real consumer
  config, pinned to a `rev:` tag
- [rotate-logs.sh](rotate-logs.sh), [check_disk_usage.py](check_disk_usage.py):
  The sample utility the hooks run against

## Tech stack

- pre-commit
- Bash and Python, for the small sample utility
- detect-secrets, for the credentials checklist
- Docker or Podman, for the Dockerfile checklist (hadolint-docker)
